howItWorks: Each Stream Deck button holds ONE Elgato 'Hotkey' action that sends the listed key. The web app listens for F13-F24 (plus the Shift row) and drives the same code as the on-screen control. The browser tab with the app must be focused. A USB Stream Deck cannot control iPad Safari; plug the deck into the Mac/PC running the browser.
layoutAssumption: 15-key deck (MK.2 class), 3 rows of 5. Any deck works: only the button placement suggestion changes.
